scene.language: You're a center mid. You need to receive the ball [0](mouse clicking)[1]. Once you receive the ball, you need to evaluate your passing options to find the best pl-- teammate to pass to. The right striker's blocked off by their defender. The right winger's behind you and you have to... It's kind of at a bad angle. The left winger is a v-- decent option, but the left striker seems pretty open and since they're forward and in a threatening position to the goal, you should pass it to them [2](mouse clicking)[3][4]. Now that the left striker has received the ball, you should support them as a passing option and help attack the goal (mouse clicking)[5].
